metadata.title: Nvidia Stock News:  ‘Tens of Thousands’ AI Chips Were Used to Train Grok 4.5<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
‘Tens of Thousands’ Nvidia Chips Were Used to Train Grok 4.5. What It Means for the Stock.
Nvidia stock has bounced off its recent lows as investors rediscover their appetite for the chip maker. The launch of new artificial-intelligence models trained on its latest hardware could help it keep going.
